summary: January 2026 features: page titles match content, IPv6 single-stack and dual-stack now supported in containerized deployments and enabled by default everywhere (FEATURE_GATEWAY_IPV6_USAGE_ENABLED removed), and anonymized telemetry collected from the Ansible MCP server.
questions: Does the Ansible MCP server send telemetry?

answer_card.title: IPv6 support in AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- January 21, 2026 patch: IPv6 single-stack and dual-stack supported for **all** deployment methods, including containerized.
- The `FEATURE_GATEWAY_IPV6_USAGE_ENABLED` flag was **removed**; IPv6 is on by default.
- Earlier (December 10, 2025) it applied to OpenShift and RPM only, behind that flag.
